sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A multi-platform fire fight that recycles adds from earlier wing 6 encounters (Conjured Amalgamate, Twin Largos) alongside new hazards.

sections.heading: Platforms & positioning
bullets: Qadim has a large hitbox and periodically teleports, leaving a meteor that destroys the platform he was on — don't be standing there when he leaves.
Sea of Flame sets a platform on fire, stripping boons and applying cripple/weakness — get off a burning platform.
If no one is on Qadim's current platform, Djinn's Gaze teleports him to the nearest one with a player — don't leave him unattended.

sections.heading: Lava Elementals & Fiery Surge
bullets: When Qadim absorbs a Lava Elemental he gains a stack of Fiery Surge — each stack is +20% damage and +2% attack speed, so don't let these adds sit around.

sections.heading: Champion adds
bullets: Expect to face the Conjured Amalgamate, the largos twins Kenut and Nikare, an Ancient Invoked Hydra, and an Apocalypse Bringer across the fight — treat each with the same care as their standalone encounters.
